  "title": "Nigerian Jollof Rice",
  "description": "Rich, smoky party jollof cooked in a tomato-pepper base with fragrant bay leaves.",
  "servings": 6,
  "prep_minutes": 20,
  "cook_minutes": 60,
  "ingredients": [
    {"raw":"2 cups long grain parboiled rice","qty":2,"qtyMax":null,"unit":"cup","name":"long grain parboiled rice","note":null,"group":null,"warn":false},

    {"raw":"2 scotch bonnet peppers","qty":2,"qtyMax":null,"unit":null,"name":"scotch bonnet peppers","note":"adjust to heat preference","group":"base","warn":true},
    {"raw":"1 large onion","qty":1,"qtyMax":null,"unit":null,"name":"onion","note":null,"group":"base","warn":false},
    {"raw":"1/4 cup vegetable oil","qty":0.25,"qtyMax":null,"unit":"cup","name":"vegetable oil","note":null,"group":null,"warn":false},
    {"raw":"2 cups chicken stock","qty":2,"qtyMax":null,"unit":"cup","name":"chicken stock","note":null,"group":null,"warn":false},
    {"raw":"2 bay leaves","qty":2,"qtyMax":null,"unit":null,"name":"bay leaves","note":null,"group":"seasoning","warn":false},
    {"raw":"1 tsp curry powder","qty":1,"qtyMax":null,"unit":"tsp","name":"curry powder","note":null,"group":"seasoning","warn":false},
    {"raw":"1 tsp thyme","qty":1,"qtyMax":null,"unit":"tsp","name":"thyme","note":null,"group":"seasoning","warn":false},

  "steps": [
    {"text":"Blend the tomatoes, red bell peppers, scotch bonnet and half the onion until smooth."},
    {"text":"Heat vegetable oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Slice remaining onion and fry until golden, about 3 minutes."},
